name: InterContinental Bora Bora & Thalasso

address.street: Motu Piti Aau Bora Bora French Polynesia

insider_take: Paradise meets pioneering wellness in French Polynesia's most exclusive overwater sanctuary.
whats_special: This is the world's first luxury resort to feature a deep ocean seawater spa - the Thalasso uses mineral-rich water pumped from 3,000 feet below the Pacific for therapeutic treatments. The resort's overwater villas are positioned on a private coral garden motu, offering unobstructed views of Mount Otemanu and direct lagoon access via glass-bottom floors.
pro_tip: Book the Thalasso treatments during sunset hours - the combination of healing seawater therapies and Bora Bora's legendary golden hour creates an unforgettable sensory experience.
dont_miss: The resort's marine biology center where you can learn about coral restoration efforts, and the signature "Helios" treatment at the Thalasso spa that uses both seawater and volcanic sand from the island's ancient crater for ultimate rejuvenation.
pros: Overwater bungalows with direct lagoon access and glass floor panels
World-class Thalasso spa featuring seawater therapy treatments
Stunning panoramic views of Mount Otemanu and turquoise lagoon
Multiple dining venues including overwater restaurant experiences
cons: Remote island location requiring multiple flights and boat transfers
Premium pricing reflects exclusive luxury positioning
